data.name: Faith
data.gender_notes: Faith is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin fides, 'faith, trust', a Christian virtue name. Its root is Latin fides. A virtue name from the Christian theological virtue of faith (1 Corinthians 13:13). Faith is a Latin name meaning “Faith; trust; belief”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Faith expresses “Faith; trust; belief”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Latin fides, 'faith, trust', a Christian virtue name.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faith total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
